text:
ellie.partnerships: Heads up — HelioStack asked us to co-run a hands-on webinar + small on-site demo lab during CloudCon EU. They want marketplace listing + joint announcement timed with the event. Can we map owners?
morgan.events: Love it. Key asks from them?
ellie.partnerships: Two speaker slots (20m product talk + 30m joint live integration demo), a 6-station mini-lab (hardware loaners from BlueForge), and a Marketplace launch tile that links to the demo app. Also localized captions in FR/DE.
sam.engineer: For the demo we should lock an integration runbook. Mack from HelioStack SI will show Atlas Connector flow — we need a stable test dataset and a fallback image-only demo in case GPU loaners miss customs.
mack.partner: Confirmed — I can own the Atlas Connector walkthrough. I’ll drop a pared-down script and a docker image by Tue. Need the demo creds and a sandbox endpoint.
devon.logistics: SWAG note — HelioStack wants co-branded lapel pins + 150 regional sticker packs. Shipping cutoff for EU customs is 2 weeks out. Who has final art?
ellie.partnerships: Morgan can we coordinate art with design and set the PO? Also ask BlueForge to confirm airway handcarry for 6 units or provide a local vendor.
morgan.events: On it. I’ll request final art from design by EOD Fri. PO to finance in the morning. I’ll ping BlueForge for handcarry options.
sam.engineer: Dry-run windows: Thu 08:00-10:00 UTC (APAC-friendly) and Fri 14:00-16:00 UTC (EU/NA overlap). Please confirm speaker availability. Dry-run should include runbook + plugin install + simulated failover (use local quantized variant).
ellie.partnerships: Speakers: me (intro + roadmap), Mack (SI demo), HelioStack lead (product update). HelioStack lead asked for a short fireside segment about marketplace discoverability.
mack.partner: HelioStack lead ok with slots; will prep slides and 2 minute customer quote.
devon.logistics: Captioning/localization — vendor options: LiveCaptionsCo (real-time FR/DE) or auto-sub via platform (cheaper, less accurate). Which route?
morgan.events: Budget prefers LiveCaptionsCo for accuracy. I’ll add to event estimate.
sam.engineer: Marketplace timing — we need the tile assets (600x400), short blurb, and a demo video (<=90s). If marketplace goes live same day, coordinate release k8s tag and Canary route.
ellie.partnerships: Ops ask: route requests to dedicated demo variant with token-limited access. Can someone from runtime confirm we can spin a demo pool for the 2-hour live? @sam.engineer
sam.engineer: I can allocate a small dedicated pool (2 GPU nodes) and a fallback autoscale policy. Need the test model artifact name and expected concurrent users.
mack.partner: Expect ~40 concurrent demo sessions; will design lightweight prompts.
devon.logistics: Shipping checklist: lapel pins x150, sticker packs x150, courier labels, customs docs, local pickup point at venue. I’ll create the manifest and share tracking.
ellie.partnerships: Promo cadence: blog post + joint tweet day -7, registration open day -14, marketplace live day 0. Need PR blurbs from HelioStack by Tue.
morgan.events: I’ll draft the event page and share copy for review. Also need speaker headshots + bios (50-75 words). Please upload to the shared drive.
sam.engineer: Quick technical note: add a short timeout on live demo routes and a graceful message if the fallback kicks in. I’ll put the snippet in the runbook: ```if token_bucket.empty then show_demo_video()```
mack.partner: Will attach the demo creds and docker image link to the thread by EOD Mon.
deploy-bot: Deployed demo-pool request #3821: 2 GPU nodes scheduled for 2026-05-12T07:00:00Z -> 2026-05-12T10:30:00Z.
ellie.partnerships: Great — next steps: Morgan (art + page), Devon (swag manifest + courier), Sam (demo pool + runbook), Mack (slides + docker + creds). I’ll compile the timeline and send a calendar invite for dry-runs. :rocket:
